text: You have the access point plus device that is called router. If you don't know what a router is, don't worry, forget about it, okay? But let's just call it access point. Now on the receiver, you have again the physical layer, the MAC layer, and then somewhere there are other other layers, okay? Let's focus on these layers that are Wi-Fi. So your transmitter, when it transmits the signal on the air, this signal travels still the antenna of the receiver. And here on the physical layer, we have the demodulation operation that we mentioned yesterday, okay? So the signal gets demodulated, that means that we extract the bits from the signal, okay? And also here they are grouped into packets. And this packet is then sent up to the MAC layer, that in Wi-Fi will apply the stop and wait technique.
